svg.text: Which should you choose?
Start with a monolith when…
• You're early-stage / an MVP — speed to market matters
• The team is small (a few engineers)
• The domain is still unclear / changing fast
• The app is simple or moderate in size
• You have limited DevOps / platform capability
• Strong consistency (ACID) is central
Horizontal scaling still works — a monolith
behind a load balancer scales a long way.
Move to microservices when…
• Many teams need to ship independently
• The domain has clear, stable boundaries
• Parts need very different scaling
• You have mature CI/CD, monitoring, orchestration
• Different parts want different tech stacks
• The monolith's build/deploy/coupling is real pain
The trigger is organizational & operational pain,
not "microservices are modern."
"Monolith first." Most teams should start with a (well-modularized) monolith and extract services only when concrete pain
justifies the added complexity. Premature microservices slow you down; a distributed monolith is worse than either.
